title: The Last Echo Revisited
author: A. M. Lockridge
blurb: Freya Eastwick, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
